methodologyNotes: Ten actively sold or recently notable automatic self-cleaning litter boxes, each re-verified 2026-06-19 against the manufacturer product page plus a reputable secondary source. Prices are published US figures for the exact named model/config; where a manufacturer shows a regular MSRP and a current sale price, priceUsd reflects the prominent current/from price and priceNote records the regular MSRP. Dimensions in inches as reported by manufacturer (footprint W x D x height where applicable); waste_drawer_capacity in liters or liner gallons as published; litter_type records the compatible substrate class; boolean specs (app_connectivity, weight_sensor) are true/false; capacity_cats is the manufacturer's numeric cat capacity or null when not numerically published. Fixes this pass: PetSafe Crystal Smart source SKU corrected (PAL00-16808 -> PAL00-16807, the live page); CatGenie A.I. price note clarified ($529 base / from $499 promo); Meowant MW-SC02 unreliable corroboration (shoppy-express, conflicting specs) replaced with cats.com review. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Litter-Robot 4
products.provenance: Price ('as low as $699'), 22x27 in footprint x 29.5 in height, up to 4 cats (3-25 lbs), 24 lb empty weight, SmartScale weight sensor and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi app all confirmed on whisker.com 2026-06-19. Release announced May 10, 2022 (Whisker PR Newswire). Waste drawer expressed as liner size; manufacturer states up to 8 days single-cat between empties.

products.name: Litter-Robot 3 Connect
products.priceNote: 'As low as $549' on litter-robot.com (now discontinued from direct store; ~$499 sale and via Amazon/third-party)
products.provenance: Official page (verified live 2026-06-19) shows 'as low as $549', 24.25 x 27 in footprint x 29.5 in height, 24 lb empty, and notes the model is discontinued (directs to EVO/LR5). Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) + weight sensor confirmed. First Wi-Fi Litter-Robot, 2017. Manufacturer does not publish a numeric cat capacity; set null.

products.name: PetSafe ScoopFree Crystal Smart
products.provenance: Source SKU corrected from PAL00-16808 (dead) to PAL00-16807 (live page) 2026-06-19. Price $219.99 and front-entry/covered dimensions 27.6 x 19.1 x 15.6 in confirmed on petsafe.com; crystal litter only and rake mechanism confirmed; My PetSafe app connectivity (2.4 GHz) confirmed. No dedicated weight sensor on product page; set false. Release ~2020 (CamelCamelCamel tracking start). Waste volume not published; set null.

products.name: PetSafe ScoopFree SmartSpin
products.provenance: Price $399.99, 6 L sealed waste drawer, SmartSpin sifting/rotating mechanism, weight change detection, and Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) Pet Companion app confirmed on petsafe.com 2026-06-19. 'Compatible with any litter' (clumping recommended). Released July 10, 2024 (PR Newswire). Cat capacity not numerically published; set null.

products.name: Leo's Loo Too
products.priceNote: Regular price $599.99 on casaleopet.com (a $699.99 'sale' figure is also shown on page)
products.provenance: Regular price $599.99 confirmed on casaleopet.com 2026-06-19; 9.5 L waste drawer, 4 weight sensors (detect cats as light as 1 lb), 100% clay-clumping litter only, rotating drum, UV sterilization, and iOS/Android app (Alexa/Google voice) confirmed. Up to 4 cats stated. Dimensions 22 in wide x 27.6 in tall corroborated via Amazon listing (Casa Leo, formerly Smarty Pear). Released 2021.
